form.label: Alert Detail
form.description: Triage one detection: what the rule was looking for, the event that matched it, and what else happened on that host at the time.

search.query: index=sigma_alerts $rule_tok$ $host_tok$ $sev_tok$ | lookup sigma_rules sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_technique_name, sigma_tactic_name, sigma_confidence, sigma_confidence_score, sigma_falsepositives, sigma_disposition, sigma_platform, sigma_source_url | eval when = strftime(sigma_first_seen, "%F %T"), seen_for = case(sigma_span_seconds <= 0, "a single event", sigma_span_seconds < 60, sigma_span_seconds." seconds", sigma_span_seconds < 3600, round(sigma_span_seconds/60,0)." minutes", 1==1, round(sigma_span_seconds/3600,1)." hours"), technique = if(sigma_technique_name="" OR isnull(sigma_technique_name), "no technique mapped", sigma_technique_name), tactic = if(sigma_tactic_name="" OR isnull(sigma_tactic_name), "unmapped", sigma_tactic_name), urgency = if(sigma_disposition="immediate", "act now", "trend") | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='CommandLine'>(?<evt_cmdline>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='Image'>(?<evt_image>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='ParentImage'>(?<evt_parent>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='User'>(?<evt_user>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='ParentCommandLine'>(?<evt_parentcmd>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "\\bexe=\"(?<aud_exe>[^\"]+)\"" | rex field=sigma_sample "\\bcomm=\"(?<aud_comm>[^\"]+)\"" | rex field=sigma_sample "\\bauid=(?<aud_user>\\S+)" | rex field=sigma_sample "\\ba0=\"(?<aud_a0>[^\"]*)\"" | rex field=sigma_sample "\\ba1=\"(?<aud_a1>[^\"]*)\"" | rex field=sigma_sample "\\ba2=\"(?<aud_a2>[^\"]*)\"" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='NewProcessName'>(?<sec_image>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='ParentProcessName'>(?<sec_parent>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='SubjectUserName'>(?<sec_user>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='ProcessCommandLine'>(?<sec_cmd>[^<]*)" | eval evt_image = coalesce(evt_image, sec_image, aud_exe, aud_comm), evt_parent = coalesce(evt_parent, sec_parent), evt_cmdline = coalesce(evt_cmdline, sec_cmd), evt_user = coalesce(evt_user, sec_user), evt_user = coalesce(evt_user, aud_user), evt_cmdline = coalesce(evt_cmdline, trim(coalesce(aud_a0,"")." ".coalesce(aud_a1,"")." ".coalesce(aud_a2,"")))
index=sigma_alerts | stats count by sigma_rule | sort - count
index=sigma_alerts | stats count by sigma_src_host | sort - count
| search technique!="no technique mapped" | stats dc(technique)
| eval r=case(sigma_level="critical",4,sigma_level="high",3,sigma_level="medium",2,1==1,1) | stats max(r) as r | eval v=case(r=4,"critical",r=3,"high",r=2,"medium",1==1,"low") | fields v

panel.title: Detections — select one to read the evidence

search.query: | eval st = mvindex(sigma_src_sourcetype, 0), idx = mvindex(sigma_src_index, 0), from_t = tostring(floor(coalesce(sigma_first_seen, 0) - 1800)), to_t = tostring(ceiling(coalesce(sigma_last_seen, sigma_first_seen, 0) + 1800)) | table when, sigma_src_host, sigma_rule, technique, tactic, sigma_level, sigma_confidence, urgency, sigma_match_count, seen_for, st, sigma_rule_id, idx, from_t, to_t, sigma_rule_id as rid | sort - when

| search sigma_rule="$sel_rule$" sigma_src_host="$sel_host$" | head 1 | eval "Process"=coalesce(evt_image,"not captured for this source type"), "Command line"=coalesce(evt_cmdline,"not captured for this source type"), "Parent process"=coalesce(evt_parent,"not captured for this source type"), "Parent command line"=coalesce(evt_parentcmd,"not captured for this source type"), "User"=coalesce(evt_user,"not captured for this source type"), "Host"=sigma_src_host, "When"=when, "Matching events"=sigma_match_count." over ".seen_for, "Source type"=sigma_src_sourcetype, "Index"=sigma_src_index | fields - _* | fields "When","Host","User","Process","Command line","Parent process", "Parent command line","Matching events","Source type","Index" | transpose column_name="Field" | rename "row 1" as "Value"

panel.title: Why this rule fired, and what it gets wrong

search.query: | search sigma_rule="$sel_rule$" sigma_src_host="$sel_host$" | head 1 | lookup sigma_rule_logic sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_condition, sigma_description | eval "What it looks for"=coalesce(sigma_description,"no description"), "Sigma condition"=coalesce(sigma_condition,"unavailable"), "ATT&CK technique"=technique." (".sigma_attack.")", "Tactic"=tactic, "Confidence"=sigma_confidence." (".sigma_confidence_score."/100)", "Handling"=if(urgency="act now", "Alerts on a single match: this rule is both severe and specific.", "Recorded and baselined; its value is the pattern, not one occurrence."), "Known false positives"=if(sigma_falsepositives="", "The author declared none. That is not the same as there being none.", sigma_falsepositives) | fields - _* | fields "What it looks for","Sigma condition","ATT&CK technique","Tactic", "Confidence","Handling","Known false positives" | transpose column_name="Field" | rename "row 1" as "Value"
index=$sel_idx|s$ host=$sel_host|s$ [| inputlookup sigma_rule_logic.csv where sigma_rule_id=$sel_ruleid|s$ | eval search=if(sigma_spl="", "*", sigma_spl) | fields search]

index=sigma_alerts sigma_src_host="$sel_host$" | lookup sigma_rules sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_technique_name | eval when=strftime(sigma_first_seen,"%F %T"), technique=if(sigma_technique_name="","no technique mapped",sigma_technique_name) | table when, sigma_rule, technique, sigma_level, sigma_match_count | rename when as "When", sigma_rule as "Rule", technique as "Technique", sigma_level as "Severity", sigma_match_count as "Events" | sort - "When"

index=$sel_idx|s$ host=$sel_host|s$ [| inputlookup sigma_rule_logic.csv where sigma_rule_id=$sel_ruleid|s$ | eval search=if(sigma_spl="", "*", sigma_spl) | fields search] | eval when=strftime(_time,"%F %T.%3N") | rex field=_raw "Name='(?<_k>[^']+)'>(?<_v>[^<]*)" max_match=60 | table when, host, sourcetype, EventCode, Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, ParentCommandLine, User, IntegrityLevel, CurrentDirectory, OriginalFileName, Hashes, exe, comm, auid, a0, a1, a2, a3 | sort - when

panel.title: Which fields those events carry — what the rule had to work with

search.query: index=$sel_idx|s$ host=$sel_host|s$ [| inputlookup sigma_rule_logic.csv where sigma_rule_id=$sel_ruleid|s$ | eval search=if(sigma_spl="", "*", sigma_spl) | fields search] | fieldsummary maxvals=3 | eval coverage=round(count/max(count)*100,0) | table field, count, distinct_count, values | rename field as "Field", count as "Events with it", distinct_count as "Distinct values", values as "Sample values" | sort - "Events with it"

html.div: Select a detection above to read the event that triggered it, what the rule was looking for, and what else happened on that host.
